# Ring MCP

> Universal Ring Security Ecosystem Control — FastMCP 3.4+ server for Ring doorbell, security camera, burglar alarm, and fire alarm management.

## Docs
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — Full tool reference, env vars, architecture
- [README.md](README.md) — Setup, configuration, API examples
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — Version history
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) — Installation guide

## Quick Start
```bash
uvx ring-mcp
```
